sanskrit_verse:
पुण्यात् षड्भागमादत्ते न्यायेन परिपालयन् ।
सर्वदानाधिकं यस्मात् प्रजानां परिपालनम् ॥ ३३५
transliteration: puṇyāt ṣaḍbhāgam ādatte nyāyena paripālayan / sarvadānādhikaṃ yasmāt prajānāṃ paripālanam // YajñS_1.335
sph_interpretive_translation: One who governs by Dharma and protects subjects according to Nyāya receives one-sixth portion of merit generated from righteous action, since protection of beings surpasses all forms of giving.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Dharma, not force or title
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to protective capability
Restoration logic prioritizes integration over isolation
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of governance
executable_legal_axioms: IF a ruler enforces laws aligned with Dharma AND ensures subject welfare THEN merit accrues automatically at one-sixth rate of total societal virtue generated
IF protection of life exceeds material distribution THEN governance value supersedes economic policy
IF a leader acts without punitive intent AND restores systemic balance THEN legal merit multiplies across generations
IF capacity for protection is unmet due to negligence THEN automatic disqualification from merit-sharing occurs
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that judicial authority must be measured not by punitive enforcement but by its contribution to collective well-being through dharmic alignment. The court's legitimacy rests upon its role as protector of prajā (subjects), which inherently outweighs any financial or administrative decision-making power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyāya here functions as precise alignment between action and consequence within consciousness—not external imposition. Protection arises sequentially from inner realization of unity with subjects, thus ensuring no punitive distortion. Responsibility flows naturally where capacity exists; hence, merit allocation follows causal integrity rather than arbitrary attribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Leader must demonstrate sustained restoration of public trust through transparent dharmic conduct
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Ruler voluntarily accepts corrective measures when misalignment detected
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Continuous upgradation of awareness via scriptural immersion and community feedback loops
Integrity Reintegration Cycle: Public affirmation rituals reaffirming commitment to non-exploitative governance
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: true sovereignty lies in service to consciousness, never domination over it. Merit flows only where protection aligns with Dharma. Thus, justice is executed, dharma is restored, and reality remains ever non-punitive under the eternal witness of pure awareness.
